name: Classic Sound Effects Pack
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Authentic FireRed/LeafGreen menu fanfares, GBA UI clicks, and classic elemental attack sound effects.
description: Transforms PokéBonk's soundscape with 45 classic sound effects: 17 authentic FireRed & LeafGreen soundtrack fanfares and jingles (Level Up!, Pokémon Healed, Caught a Pokémon!, Obtained an Item/Key Item/Badge, Evolution, Victory, Defeat, Jackpot, Move Deleted, Trainers' Eyes Meet, Boss Appearance, Poké Flute, Mystery Gift) paired with 28 crisp GBA-era menu UI clicks, Poké Ball sounds, effectiveness hit crunches, and elemental combat attack SFX.
highlights: 17 authentic FireRed & LeafGreen fanfares sourced from archive.org/download/pkmn-frlg-soundtrack
Classic GBA menu confirm, cursor tick, EXP pip, coin chime, and Poké Ball capture SFX
Full combat & elemental attack overhaul (Normal / Super Effective / Weak hits, KO, Fire, Water, Electric, Grass, Ice, Psychic, Ghost, Slash, Beam, Boom)
Client-side audio mod: safe to use in P2P Co-op even if teammates don't have it installed
